subject: Zalthir
fact: Zalthir set the book back exactly as it lay, careful that the owner would never know a hand had touched it.
source_quote: I set the book back exactly as it lay, careful enough that he would never know a hand had touched it.

subject: Daz
fact: Daz would note the locked safe without regret, because the group is not the famed Whistler, no safecracker of that old generation among them.
source_quote: Daz would note it without regret: we are not the famed Whistler, no safecracker of that old generation among us.

subject: Glabbagool
fact: Glabbagool could not thin himself past the safe's one-finger-width opening; the safe was left shut to keep its secret.
source_quote: Glabbagool could not thin himself past it. We left the safe to keep its secret.

subject: Bookwyrm
fact: Bookwyrm's chambers took half the top floor — comfortable, neatly arranged, no extravagance; Zalthir entered and found nothing.
source_quote: Bookwyrm last, and by then the tower was fighting me. Her chambers took half the top floor — comfortable, neatly arranged, no extravagance to it. I got in. I found nothing.

subject: blistered rats
fact: Jars of blistered rats were found as part of the investigation.

subject: missing birds
fact: A cage was missing three birds as part of the investigation.

subject: marked page
fact: A page was marked to a poisoning by gift, indicating a potential clue.
source_quote: A page marked to a poisoning by gift.

subject: Readers' Chambers
fact: The Readers' Chambers contained a locked safe, marked book, jars of blistered rats, a missing bird cage, and Bookwyrm's chambers on the top floor.
source_quote: A man with jars of poisoned rats had marked his page... Beside it, a locked safe... Bookwyrm last... her chambers took half the top floor.

subject: Midnight Tears
fact: The name 'Midnight Tears' was retained as a lead, not to be lost.
source_quote: Midnight Tears. I kept the name where I would not lose it.

subject: lead from poisoning by gift
fact: A lead emerged from a marked page concerning a poisoning by gift, alongside other clues.
source_quote: We had several. A cage missing three birds. Jars of blistered rats. A page marked to a poisoning by gift.

subject: search conclusion
fact: The search concluded with multiple leads identified and no direct evidence found, but information gathered.
source_quote: I found nothing. Glabbagool tasted the air and found no poison in it. A clean room. That, too, was information. We had several.
